Season 01 · Included benefits

What will you get?

Here is what your No-Ghosting Deposit includes.

    THE BELIEVING ROOM

    Registration Terms & Conditions

    1. Seat lock: Your registration fee (₹500 for candidates, ₹300 for audience) confirms your seat. A registration is complete only after payment is received and confirmed.
    2. No refunds: All fees are non-refundable, including for no-shows, late arrivals and personal cancellations.
    3. Transfers: You can transfer your registration to another person up to 48 hours before the show. Email us the new person's name and contact details before the deadline. No transfers are accepted after that.
    4. Candidate transfers: A candidate slot can be transferred only if the new person is approved by The Believing Room team, since candidates are shortlisted for panel fit.
    5. If we cancel or postpone: If we cancel, you get a full refund. If we postpone, you can choose a full refund or keep your seat for the new date.
    6. What's included: Lunch and goodies for all attendees. Panel review and guidance for all candidates. An offer letter for selected candidates only. Selection depends entirely on the panel's decision, and registration does not guarantee an offer.
    7. Recording consent: The show is filmed and published on YouTube and social media. By registering, you consent to being recorded and to your image, voice and performance being used in the show and related promotion.
    8. Arrival: Please arrive at the time on your confirmation. Late arrivals may lose their slot or seat without refund.
    9. Conduct: Respectful behaviour is required. We may remove anyone who disrupts the show or disrespects candidates, panelists or staff, with no refund.
    10. Eligibility and ID: Participants must be 18 or older and carry valid photo ID.
    11. Payment charges: Payment gateway fees, if any, are not refundable.
    12. Changes: We may update the schedule, venue or panel if needed, and we'll inform registered participants.
